title: KNK437 Suppresses the Growth of Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Cells by Targeting Heat Shock Factor 1.
authors: Wu, Lili; Feng, Jieni; Lin, Hualong; Chen, Peirui
one_liner_zh: 该文研究HSF1抑制剂KNK437对非小细胞肺癌的抑癌作用，仅含分子对接但对象为蛋白-小分子，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Heat shock factor 1 (HSF1) has emerged as a promising therapeutic target in various solid tumors. However, its specific role in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and the potential efficacy of HSF1 inhibitors in this context remain largely unexplored. The current data showed that HSF1 is overexpressed in NSCLC cells and is positively associated with poorer survival outcomes in NSCLC patients. Moreover, the HSF1 inhibitor KNK437 markedly suppresses NSCLC cell proliferation and induces dose-dependent cell cycle arrest and apoptosis. In addition, KNK437 significantly alters the expression of HSF1 and its downstream target genes in HSF1-overexpressing NSCLC cells, while HSF1 knockdown markedly attenuates the anti-proliferative effects of KNK437, indicating that its therapeutic efficacy is largely mediated through HSF1 inhibition. Finally, molecular docking simulations revealed that KNK437 engages in hydrophobic interactions and forms two critical hydrogen bonds with HSF1, potentially underpinning its inhibitory activity. Collectively, these findings support HSF1 as a compelling molecular target for NSCLC treatment and highlight KNK437 as a promising therapeutic candidate.
abstract_zh: 热休克因子1（HSF1）已成为多种实体瘤中颇具前景的治疗靶点。然而，其在非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）中的具体作用以及HSF1抑制剂在此背景下的潜在疗效仍未得到充分探索。当前数据显示，HSF1在NSCLC细胞中过表达，并与NSCLC患者较差的生存结局呈正相关。此外，HSF1抑制剂KNK437显著抑制NSCLC细胞增殖，并诱导剂量依赖性的细胞周期阻滞和凋亡。同时，KNK437在HSF1过表达的NSCLC细胞中显著改变HSF1及其下游靶基因的表达，而HSF1敲低则明显减弱KNK437的抗增殖效应，表明其治疗功效主要通过抑制HSF1介导。最后，分子对接模拟揭示KNK437与HSF1发生疏水相互作用并形成两个关键氢键，这可能支撑其抑制活性。综合来看，这些发现支持HSF1作为NSCLC治疗的一个引人注目的分子靶点，并强调KNK437作为一种有前景的治疗候选药物。
